text: Sri (BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-23, 'Track every mistake'): 'Start tracking every mistake you make as work Athena should start being intelligent about as well'. Interventions whose text starts 'Mistake:' are mistakes of the role doing Athena's thinking for now (eleven back-filled on 2026-10-23, category other). Give them a category of their own (mistake) in the closed list, have status and the audit count mistakes per class and per cause, and have introspection of a mistake propose the check or knowledge that would have prevented it, so repeat causes become work.
